fields.Name: MJ_BizApps_SecureMessaging: Portal Sessions
fields.Description: Tracks active secure messaging sessions for external contacts. Each session maps a contact to a channel thread and is authenticated via a hashed opaque token.

fields.Name: MJ_BizApps_SecureMessaging: Portal Magic Links
fields.Description: Single-use magic links for re-authenticating expired portal sessions. Short-lived, redeems into a fresh session token.

fields.Name: MJ_BizApps_SecureMessaging: Secure Messages
fields.Description: Self-contained secure message store. Each row is one inbound or outbound message in a thread. App-agnostic: does not require an external Channel Messages entity.

fields.Name: MJ_BizApps_SecureMessaging: Message Files
fields.Description: Links an uploaded file to a secure message. Bytes are stored in core MJ File Storage (MJ: Files) and wrapped as an MJ Artifact; this table holds references and display metadata only.

fields.Name: MJ_BizApps_SecureMessaging: File Requests
fields.Description: A request from staff for the external contact to securely upload one or more files. Fulfilled by uploading files and setting Status to Fulfilled.
